# @boostengine/core

> WordPress/Shopify-style modular plugin runtime & event hook architecture for BoostEngine eCommerce stores. Version 1.1.0.

@boostengine/core is the central kernel of the BoostEngine ecosystem. It provides action/filter hooks, a decoupled event bus, a modular plugin runtime with lifecycle & health checks, a reactive store primitive, and an integer-safe currency/money engine shared by all `@boostengine/*` packages.

## Install

```bash
npm install @boostengine/core
```

## Quick start

```ts
import { createBoostEngine, type BoostPlugin } from '@boostengine/core';

const plugin: BoostPlugin = {
  id: 'my-plugin',
  name: 'My Plugin',
  version: '1.0.0',
  async init(ctx) {},
  async registerHooks(engine) {
    engine.hooks.addAction('order.created', async (order) => {});
  },
  async boot() {},
  async shutdown() {},
};

const engine = createBoostEngine({ autoStart: true });
await engine.registerPlugin(plugin);
await engine.start();
```

## API

### Hooks (WordPress/Shopify style)

- `addAction(tag, callback, priority?)`
- `doAction(tag, ...args)`
- `removeAction(tag, callback?)`
- `hasAction(tag, callback?)`
- `addFilter(tag, callback, priority?)`
- `applyFilters(tag, value, ...args)`
- `removeFilter(tag, callback?)`
- `hasFilter(tag, callback?)`
- `removeAllHooks(tag?)`
- `createHooks()` / `BoostHookSystem`

### Event Bus

- `createEventBus(options?)` -> `EventBus`
- `on(pattern, listener)` / `once(pattern, listener)` / `off(pattern, listener?)`
- `emit(topic, payload?, options?)` / `emitSync(...)`
- `replay(pattern?)` / `listenerCount(pattern?)` / `topics()` / `clear()`
- Wildcards: `*` (one segment), `**` (many segments)
- `DOMAIN_EVENTS` — `auth.*`, `cart.*`, `checkout.*`, `payment.*`, `order.*`, `inventory.*`, `shipping.*`

### Plugin Runtime

- `createBoostEngine(config?)` -> `BoostEngine`
- `registerPlugin(plugin)` / `unregisterPlugin(id)`
- `start()` / `shutdown()`
- Lifecycle: `init` -> `registerHooks` -> `boot` -> `shutdown`
- `getPlugin(id)` / `getPlugins()` / `enablePlugin` / `disablePlugin`
- `healthCheck()` / `isPluginHealthy(id)`
- Legacy: `BoostPluginEngine`, `boostCore`, `BOOST_HOOKS`

### Store

- `createStore(initialState)` / `subscribe(store, fn)` / `getState(store)` / `setState(store, update)` / `derive(store, selector)`

### Money

- `Money`, `CurrencyCode`, `PriceBreakdown`
- `addMoney` / `subtractMoney` / `multiplyMoney` / `divideMoney`
- `convertMoney(money, currency, rate)` / `formatMoney(money, options?)`
- `toMinorUnits` / `fromMinorUnits` / `getMinorUnits`

### Types

`Address`, `Customer`, `LineItem`, `Order`, `PaymentSession`, `OrderStatus`, `PaymentStatus`, `PluginContext`, `PluginCategory`.

### AI Toolkit (`@boostengine/core/ai`)

- `coreTools` — `inspect_engine_state`, `trigger_engine_event`, `evaluate_filter_pipeline`, `generate_plugin_boilerplate`
- `toOpenAITools` / `toAnthropicTools` / `toMCPTools`
- `getCoreSystemPrompt()`
